name: Sentry
description: Sentry's hosted server reads issues, events, traces and releases and can ask Seer for a root cause, so the agent fixes a bug from its real stack trace.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.sentry.dev) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
